manual_scope.target: Reusable application-layer software for quantum-computing chemistry, machine learning, optimization, or finance, including their domain models, problem-to-quantum representations and algorithm workflows. Assess the main maintained implementation, not every possible downstream use.
manual_scope.non_software: Exclude repositories primarily containing documentation, tutorials, courses, resource lists, or example collections rather than reusable implementation code.
manual_scope.infrastructure: Repositories primarily implementing a language/compiler, runtime/provider, deployment infrastructure, or a simulator engine are outside the intended application-oriented focus. Mixed frameworks require individual review; the word framework is not itself an exclusion criterion.
manual_scope.classical_science: Exclude primarily classical scientific-computing packages that model quantum-mechanical systems but do not primarily implement quantum-computing application workflows. This is a domain boundary, not a programming-language filter.
manual_scope.other_quantum_domains: For this stricter four-domain proposal, standalone quantum-networking, hardware/error-correction and quantum-information-theory tools fall outside scope. These are substantive scope restrictions requiring explicit human confirmation, not universally unsuitable quantum software.
manual_scope.repository_granularity: Assess current independent application-module boundaries. A documented predecessor or component whose functionality was split or merged into retained repositories may be proposed for exclusion as a separate repository unit. This does not establish duplicate historical tasks; archive status alone is not an exclusion.
manual_scope.boundary_cases: Mixed application/infrastructure frameworks and domain-specific simulators require individual review. If their application functionality overlaps the retained repositories, record needs_exclusion_evidence until a consistently applicable exclusion is supported.
manual_scope.instance_feasibility: For newly admitted samples, verify a feature Issue linked to its implementing PR and stable executable F2P/P2P tests under ../Build_Docker_WORKFLOW.md. Repository counts alone do not establish this.
manual_scope.unknown_evidence: Record not_audited or needs_review; never infer that no suitable Issue-PR pair or tests exist from missing audit evidence.
manual_scope.general_frameworks: Exclude primarily general quantum programming or training frameworks whose main maintained interfaces provide registers/circuits, generic quantum layers, differentiation, tensor integration or execution infrastructure. Judge the actual delivered functionality, not the word framework. A mixed project with independently maintained domain-problem models, problem-to-quantum mappings or application-level solving/prediction modules must be reviewed individually; examples alone do not establish such modules.
manual_scope.framework_comparison: TFQ PQC takes circuits/observables and emits expectation-value tensors as a Keras layer; propose E10 exclusion as a generic training framework. PennyLane also supplies a qchem Molecule API and molecular_hamiltonian mapping, with dedicated tests, so it remains a mixed project with explicit application modules. The distinction is functional and must not be generalized to excluding every quantum ML library.

reason_codes.K01: Existing application repository with sample metadata in the current dataset
reason_codes.E01: Documentation, teaching, demonstrations or SDK example collections
reason_codes.E02: Language, compiler or circuit toolchain infrastructure
reason_codes.E03: Runtime, provider, adapter, orchestration or cloud infrastructure
reason_codes.E04: General circuit representation or simulation-engine infrastructure
reason_codes.E05: Primarily classical scientific computing rather than quantum-computing applications
reason_codes.E06: Other quantum domains outside the proposed four application areas
reason_codes.E07: Packaging, environment or supporting scientific-data utilities
reason_codes.E08: Documented predecessor or merged component outside current independent-module granularity
reason_codes.E09: Circuit benchmark generation rather than application-library implementation
reason_codes.U01: Direct application-scope overlap; no supported exclusion established
reason_codes.U02: Mixed scope or unresolved abstraction boundary; needs further evidence
reason_codes.E10: Primarily general quantum programming/training framework, judged by core interfaces rather than project naming

current_cohort_policy: Record the seven repositories represented in ../samples/index.json as existing dataset membership, separately from the scope audit. Do not use absence from that index as a scope-exclusion reason. Unresolved exclusions remain needs_exclusion_evidence; this audit does not yet uniquely derive seven eligible repositories.
human_review_policy: Agent-prepared scope assessments are drafts. A human reviewer must fill the separate review fields before calling them completed human audits.

functional_scope_confirmation.rule: User confirmed functional classification: exclude general frameworks; review mixed projects with explicit application modules individually.
